grief.title: The Arc of Grief
grief.description: Every journey through loss teaches us about resilience.
grief.scripture: “For we know that if the tent that is our earthly home is destroyed, we indeed have a building from God…” — 2 Corinthians 5:1

challenges.title: The First Wave
challenges.description: You receive news of a friend's passing. The world feels heavy.

choices.label: React and cry
choices.desc: Feel it fully, but resilience drains more

challenges.title: The Long Silence
challenges.description: Days pass and the grief doesn't ease. You wonder if you'll ever feel like yourself again.

choices.label: Sit with it alone
choices.desc: Let the waves come and go

work.title: The Arc of Work
work.description: Professional challenges test your patience and self-worth.
work.scripture: “Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.” — Philippians 4:6

challenges.title: Conflict at Work
challenges.description: A difficult conversation with a colleague threatens to escalate.

challenges.title: Sense of Failure
challenges.description: A project didn't go as planned. You can't help but wonder if you're enough.

choices.label: Seek counsel
choices.desc: Talk to a mentor or trusted colleague

self.title: The Arc of Self
self.description: Nourishing your inner life is not optional — it is essential.
self.scripture: “But let your inner self be renewed by the Spirit.” — Romans 12:2

challenges.title: Morning Reflection
challenges.description: A moment to center yourself before the day begins.

challenges.title: Anxiety Wave
challenges.description: Your heart races and your mind races with worst-case scenarios.

choices.label: Breathe and observe
choices.desc: Let it pass like a cloud

choices.label: Reach out to someone
choices.desc: Let a friend know you're struggling
